result.finding: No declarative service definition files (docker-compose.yml, Kubernetes manifests, Helm charts) exist in the asset-manager project. Services are defined imperatively via scripts/deploy-to-azure.sh using Azure CLI commands. The script provisions two Azure Container Apps (web and worker), an Azure Container Apps environment, an Azure Container Registry, and supporting infrastructure (Azure Database for PostgreSQL, Azure Service Bus, Azure Storage).
evidence: No docker-compose*.yml found in asset-manager directory tree
No Kubernetes manifests (k8s/, manifests/ directories) found
scripts/deploy-to-azure.sh: imperative Azure CLI commands create Container Apps environment and two container apps (web, worker)
scripts/startapp.sh: local infrastructure started via direct 'docker run' commands (not Compose)
values: No declarative service definition files present
Deployment approach: imperative Azure CLI scripting (deploy-to-azure.sh)
Defined services (via deploy script): assets-manager-web (Container App), assets-manager-worker (Container App)
Infrastructure: Azure Container Apps environment, ACR, PostgreSQL Flexible Server, Service Bus, Blob Storage
